project_type: React Router v7 forum app with SSR, using Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui
test_framework: No test framework present - validation is build-based
verification_instructions: Run 'pnpm build' in web/ directory - must complete without errors
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed in web/node_modules. Run 'pnpm build' in /projects/sandbox/jubensha-go/web/
environment_constraints: No test suite. Build validation only. shadcn/ui components automatically pick up CSS variable changes.
contribution_requirements: Visual-only changes - no functionality changes. All colors must use CSS custom properties (var(--color-*)), not hardcoded hex. Both light and dark mode must work.
key_patterns: 1. CSS files in web/styles/ use @layer components. 2. Components use Tailwind utility classes referencing shadcn variables (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border). 3. Custom CSS uses var(--border), var(--primary), var(--muted) etc which are mapped to design tokens in globals.css. 4. Layout uses MainShell wrapper with aside prop. 5. Design tokens defined in :root and .dark in globals.css.
directory_structure: web/app/routes/ - All page routes (file-based routing). web/components/ - Reusable components organized by domain (topic/, user/, auth/, common/, layout/, dashboard/, tasks/, search/, editor/). web/styles/ - CSS files: globals.css (imports+tokens), variables.css (animations), topic.css, content.css, auth.css, editor.css, user.css, pages.css, common.css (layout). web/lib/ - Utilities, API client, i18n.
